Ayesha Kulkarni | ayesha.kulkarni947@example.com | +91 9595902887
Pune
Not open to relocation; looking for roles in Pune only
Notice period: 90 days

Professional Summary
Detail-oriented QA Automation Engineer with experience across web and API testing, automation frameworks, and CI pipelines. Proven track record delivering reliable test suites, improving test coverage, and reducing regression cycle time through automation and tooling.

Technical Skills
Selenium, Test Automation, TestNG, Postman, Jenkins, Playwright, JUnit, Linux, Confluence

Work Experience

Senior QA Automation Engineer, Bluefin Logistics (Aug 2023 - Jun 2026)
- Designed and implemented TestNG-based automation framework for logistics web portal, integrating Playwright for cross-browser end-to-end test execution, reducing manual regression time by 60%.
- Built CI pipelines in Jenkins to execute nightly Playwright suites on Linux agents and report TestNG results to Confluence dashboards for stakeholder visibility.
- Developed automated test cases for shipment tracking, rate calculation, and booking flows using Playwright and Selenium components, increasing automated coverage of critical flows to 85%.

Test Engineer, Ola (Apr 2023 - Jul 2023)
- Created Playwright end-to-end tests for rider and passenger web workflows, validating UI flows and edge cases to catch release-blocking defects early.
- Automated API contract and functional checks using Postman collections integrated into Jenkins, enabling automated smoke runs on every build.
- Documented test plans and results in Confluence and collaborated with developers to triage issues identified by automated suites.

SDET, Cognizant (Feb 2017 - Mar 2023)
- Developed and maintained JUnit and TestNG test suites for enterprise applications, implementing Playwright-based UI tests for modern web clients.
- Implemented CI/CD test automation with Jenkins jobs triggering Linux-based automation runners, reducing regression feedback loop from days to hours.
- Led efforts to standardize Test Automation practices and integrate results into Confluence, mentoring team members on Selenium and Playwright usage.

QA Automation Engineer, Trellis Systems (Aug 2016 - Jan 2017)
- Implemented Selenium-based automation for enterprise web applications and introduced Playwright components to handle modern JavaScript-heavy pages.
- Integrated automated test runs into Jenkins pipelines on Linux build agents and maintained test documentation in Confluence.
- Created reusable Test Automation utilities and helped stabilize flaky UI tests, improving pipeline reliability.

Education
B.Tech, Computer Science, VIT Vellore
